newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portugal's Cimpor drops on sell order.
newsitem.headline: Portugal's Cimpor drops on sell order.

text.p: Shares in Portuguese cement group Cimpor-Cimentos de Portugal hit a low of 3,722 escudos on Lisbon bourse due to a sell order, but the stock was not expected to fall below that level, dealers said.
"There is a sell order in the market, which has emerged in recent days, but it looks as though there is support around 3,720 escudos," said one operator who asked not to be identified.
Another said: "It is possible that the order in the market has not been executed yet."
Cimpor later recovered to stand at 3,770 escudos, down 78, in volume of 140,482 shares at 1450 GMT.
